title: Invertibility of the integral comparison on each permitted pair.
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and $g:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ an isomorphism of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Write $F=Lg^*$, $T$ and $H$ for the integral constructible pullback, tensor and internal Hom on its permitted Hom pairs [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations], $\mu_{L,M}:F(T(L,M))\cong T(FL,FM)$ for the canonical integral pullback-tensor comparison [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-construction], and $c_P:F H(P)\to H(FP)$ for the evaluation-defined comparison between the completed integral partial closed data on $Y$ and $X$, $c_P=\operatorname{tr}_X(\mu^{-1}\circ F(\mathrm{ev}_P))$ [def-sf-adic-closed-reindexing-maps, def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces]; a permitted pair $P=(M,N)$ pulls back to a permitted pair $FP$ [lem-pod-reindexing-hom-coefficient-descent]. Then $c_P$ is an isomorphism for every permitted pair $P$ on $Y$.

proof.text: Reindexing along the isomorphism of sites is an exact equivalence preserving K-flat and K-injective complexes, and its ambient product-Hom comparison $c^0_{M,N}$ is an isomorphism for arbitrary inputs [lem-pod-reindexing-hom-resolution-model]; the evaluation calculus identifies $c^0$ with the unique map satisfying the evaluation equation [lem-pod-reindexing-evaluation-shift-composition].

On complete inputs the completion-unit lemma identifies exact reindexing with the recorded completed pullback and its tensor comparison with $\mu$ [lem-pod-reindexing-completion-unit-tensor]; the reflection lemma extends ordinary evaluation uniquely along the completion unit and restricts $c^0$ to the Hom-constructible pairs [lem-pod-reindexing-completed-evaluation-reflection]. By that uniqueness $c_P$ is the restriction of $c^0$, and a full-subcategory arrow with invertible underlying arrow is invertible.
